about: About Edelweiss Nifty Next 50 Index Fund Edelweiss Nifty Next 50 Index Fund Direct Growth is an equity fund. This fund was started on 30 November, 2022. The fund is managed by Manasi Jalgaonkar, Bhavesh Jain. The fund could potentially beat inflation in the long-run. Key Parameters Edelweiss Nifty Next 50 Index Fund has ₹303 Cr worth of assets under management (AUM) as on Sep 2026 and is more than category average. The fund has an expense ratio 0.2. Returns Edelweiss Nifty Next 50 Index Fund has given a CAGR return of 14.68% since inception. Over the last 1 and 3 years the fund has given a CAGR return of 4.04% and 17.41% respectively. Holdings Edelweiss Nifty Next 50 Index Fund has allocated its funds majorly in Cash Equivalent, Financial Services, Consumer Cyclical, Industrial, Utilities, Basic Materials, Consumer Defensive, Health, Energy, Real Estate, Tech. Its top holdings are Divi's Laboratories Ltd, TVS Motor Co Ltd, Tata Motors Ltd, Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd Ordinary Shares, Adani Power Ltd Taxation As it is a index funds mutual fund the taxation is as follows: For short term (less than a year) capital gains will be taxed at 20% For long term (more than 1 year) capital gains will be taxed at 12.5% without indexation benefit Dividends will always be taxed at slab rate. Long term gains upto Rs 1 lakh are exempt capital gains tax. Investment objective of Edelweiss Nifty Next 50 Index Fund The investment objective of the scheme is to provide returns before expenses that closely correspond to the total returns of the Nifty Next 50 Index subject to tracking errors. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be realized and the Scheme does not assure or guarantee any returns. Minimum Investment and lockin period Minimum investment for lump sum payment is INR 100.00 and for SIP is INR 100.00. Edelweiss Nifty Next 50 Index Fund has no lock in period.
